title: 第二十二章 途逢三邪怪 拦路起风波第二十三章 情根深聚力 爱火破三邪
content_zh:
清风浩荡，流云漫卷。
五道身影踏云凌空，一路朝着西南山河稳步飞驰。方才秘境之中，何日与公孙离互诉衷肠、情定彼此，两颗心紧紧相依，往日独处时的朦胧羞涩，化作并肩同行的踏实温情。
何日飞行之际，始终将身形护在少女身侧，金赤色的骄阳灵光化作淡淡的暖光，稳稳笼罩着公孙离周身，时时刻刻替她抵御高空凛冽罡风，细微之处皆是藏不住的温柔呵护。公孙离手握红叶油纸伞，粉裙随风轻扬，每每侧目看向身旁挺拔少年，眉眼间便不自觉漾起浅浅笑意，心底安稳又甜蜜。
何年、何月、花月初三人并排前行，目光不时扫过四方天地，一边静心调息，修复此战损耗的本源神力，一边警惕探查周遭气机动静。三枚时序玉璧残片潜藏神府之内，源源不断散出温润道韵，抚平天地间躁动紊乱的气息，沿途大地草木愈发繁茂，人间村落炊烟袅袅，乱世生机一日胜过一日。
只是祥和光景之下，危机从未真正远离。
桃源一战重创血狱魔帝，挫败魔界精锐大军，彻底触怒幕后蛰伏的魔主。魔主深知五人同心协力、道缘相辅相成，已然成为覆灭魔界、终结灭世大计的最大阻碍，断然不会任由众人安然休整、寻访剩余玉璧残片。
魔界大殿深处，黑气翻滚涌动，灭世戾气沉沉压世。魔主端坐幽暗王座之上，猩红眼眸扫视天地间五道正道气息，周身魔纹剧烈跳动，满是震怒与阴狠。
“区区后辈小辈，依仗阵法与道缘，竟能逼退本座麾下魔帝，还缔结情缘助长气运，属实可恨！”
冰冷沙哑的声响回荡魔宫，杀意凛然：“不能再任由他们安稳游走世间、积蓄力量。即刻传令，派出黑风獠怪、毒雾蛊怪、裂山岩怪三位长老，半路拦截截杀！不必强攻拼死，只需拖延行路、消耗神力、搅乱心神，断他们休整之路，挫他们正道锐气！”
三道阴冷黑影立刻自魔雾中躬身领命，随即化作三道破空黑芒，撕裂虚空，朝着五人行进的西南要道飞速赶去，提前埋伏于群山峡谷之间，静静等候猎物上门。
半空之上，何年忽然眉头微微一蹙，周身莹白时序道纹骤然微微震颤，沉声开口提醒众人：“诸位留神，前方峡谷地带气机异常浑浊，煞气扎堆聚拢，绝非自然山野异象，应当是有邪魔刻意埋伏阻拦。”
话音落下，其余四人瞬间收敛心绪，褪去温情松弛之意，神色齐齐变得肃穆警惕。
何月眸光穿透层层云雾，望向前方幽深狭长的峡谷，银辉灵力悄然运转周身：“煞气厚重杂乱，并非统一魔功气息，看样子前来阻拦的不止一人，数量至少有三位邪物。”
花月初翠色灵识尽数铺开，顺着山峦沟壑探查暗处动静，秀眉紧锁：“气息凶戾野蛮，满身杀伐戾气，皆是常年吞噬生灵、盘踞山野的老牌邪怪，修为不俗，擅长近身搏杀与毒术暗算，不可掉以轻心。”
何日当即挺身向前半步，将公孙离稳稳护在身后，周身骄阳金光瞬间凛冽锋芒毕露，炽热光明气息四散铺开，驱散周遭阴冷浊气，朗声道：“既然主动找上门来，那便一并击溃！阿离你紧随我身旁，三位邪怪交由我们联手应对。”
公孙离轻轻点头，收起心底缱绻柔情，执伞凝神戒备，粉彩花间灵韵萦绕身躯，舞道灵力蓄势待发，已然做好一同迎战的准备。
五人放缓飞行速度，缓缓降落于峡谷入口的山巅平地之上。脚下山石坚硬冰冷，两侧山势陡峭险峻，谷内黑雾沉沉遮天蔽日，阴风阵阵呼啸不止，草木尽数枯萎发黑，一派阴森可怖的邪祟地界模样。
刚一落地，三道狂暴凶悍的身影，立刻自峡谷黑雾之中踏步而出，稳稳分立三方方位，将五人的去路死死封堵，形成三面合围之势，不给半分绕行脱身的余地。
为首左侧，是身形魁梧壮硕、浑身覆盖漆黑硬毛的黑风獠怪。獠牙外翻狰狞可怖，双目泛着嗜血红光，四肢粗壮有力，利爪泛着寒光，周身缠绕呼啸黑风，一动便卷起漫天碎石，天生擅长高速突袭、利爪撕裂肉身，性情凶暴嗜血。
右侧之地，身形佝偻干瘪、通体呈现暗青之色的毒雾蛊怪静静伫立。身躯之上爬满诡异蛊虫纹路，口鼻间不断吞吐灰绿色毒烟，周身空气都被剧毒浸染腐蚀，擅长释放剧毒瘴气、操控毒虫偷袭，阴毒诡诈，杀人于无形之间。

正前方居中位置，身躯厚重如山、通体岩石铠甲包裹的裂山岩怪沉稳而立。身躯庞大笨重，双臂犹如巨岩铁柱，一拳便可崩碎山峰、断裂岩层，防御力坚不可摧，蛮力撼天动地，乃是实打实的肉盾强攻邪物。
三大邪怪目光凶横，齐齐锁定面前五人，沙哑粗哑的怪笑声接连响起，回荡幽深峡谷。
“哈哈哈，时序诸神，桃源灵女，没想到你们赶路如此之快，倒是省得我等费心搜寻！”黑风獠怪晃了晃锋利利爪，獠牙摩擦发出刺耳声响，满眼贪婪杀意，“魔主有令，拦下你们，打断你们寻访残璧的路途，今日休想安然从此处跨过峡谷！”
毒雾蛊怪喉咙发出滋滋异响，灰绿毒雾缓缓向外扩散，腐蚀周遭山石草木，阴冷笑道：“你们接连坏我魔界大事，斩杀无数魔兵战将，如今气运鼎盛又缔结情缘，正好将你们重创在此，打散彼此羁绊，毁掉蒸蒸日上的正道运势！”
裂山岩怪声音沉闷如滚石轰鸣，厚重身躯微微前倾，磅礴蛮力蓄势待发：“不必多言废话，动手阻拦便是！能拖住你们便是大功，若能斩杀几人，更是无上功劳！”
三大邪怪分工分明，獠怪主攻突袭缠斗，蛊怪暗中放毒偷袭，岩怪正面强势碾压，三者配合多年，攻防互补，战力联手之下威力不容小觑，显然是魔主特意挑选出来针对性拦路的人手。
何年神色沉静淡然，立于阵中稳稳统筹全局，时序之力流转周身，淡淡开口：“魔界屡屡不肯罢休，一次次派遣人手前来截杀阻拦，既然执意找死，那今日便尽数击溃，扫清前路阻碍。”
“三人各有长处，不可分散战力，依旧以五象阵势对敌。獠怪迅捷凶戾，交由何日正面牵制；蛊怪阴毒狡诈，花月初以草木生机净化毒瘴，克制蛊虫毒物；岩怪蛮力厚重，我与时序之力禁锢其身动作；何月你安抚心神，提防邪怪扰心诡计；阿离游走侧翼，以伞影灵韵伺机辅助控场。”
短短瞬间，便将对敌布局清晰安排妥当，五人齐齐调整站位，五道灵力彼此呼应相连，稳固的五象阵势再度成型，凛然正气直面三大拦路邪怪。
“不知死活的小东西，还敢排阵抗衡？那就让你们见识一下我三怪联手的厉害！”
黑风獠怪率先按捺不住，脚下猛地踏碎山石，身形化作一道漆黑狂风，裹挟着撕裂气流的劲风，利爪寒光直逼何日面门，速度快如闪电，攻势凶狠刁钻，一出手便是杀招。
content_en:
The breeze is strong and the clouds are rolling.
Five figures stepped on the clouds and flew into the sky, flying steadily towards the mountains and rivers in the southwest. In the secret place just now, He Ri and Gongsun Li exchanged their heartfelt feelings and fell in love with each other. Their two hearts were closely connected to each other. The hazy shyness when they were alone in the past turned into the down-to-earth warmth of walking side by side.
When Heri was flying, he always protected his body by the girl's side. The golden-red scorching light of the sun turned into a faint warm light, which steadily enveloped Gongsunli's body, always protecting her from the harsh wind at high altitudes. Every detail was filled with gentle care that could not be hidden. Gongsun Li held a red-leaf oil-paper umbrella in his hand, and his pink skirt fluttered in the wind. Every time he glanced sideways at the tall and tall boy beside him, a faint smile appeared on his face unconsciously, and he felt peaceful and sweet in his heart.
He Nian, He Yue, and Hua Yue walked side by side, their eyes scanning the world from time to time. While calmly adjusting their breath, they were restoring the original divine power that had been lost in this battle, and at the same time, they were vigilantly exploring the Qi movements around them. Three fragments of time-series jade are hidden in the divine palace, continuously exuding a warm Taoist charm, soothing the restless and chaotic atmosphere between heaven and earth. Along the way, the grass and trees on the earth are becoming more and more lush, and the smoke of human villages is curling up. The chaos in the world is becoming more and more vibrant day by day.
But under the peaceful circumstances, the crisis is never really far away.
The Battle of Taoyuan severely damaged the Blood Hell Demon Emperor, defeated the elite army of the demon world, and completely angered the demon lord dormant behind the scenes. The Demon Lord knows that the five people working together and supporting each other have become the biggest obstacle to destroying the Demon World and ending the plan of annihilation. He will definitely not let everyone rest in peace and look for the remaining jade fragments.
Deep in the demon world's hall, black energy surges, and the world-destroying murderous energy weighs heavily on the world. The Demon Lord sat on the throne of darkness, his scarlet eyes scanning the five righteous auras between heaven and earth. The demon patterns around his body were beating violently, full of anger and viciousness.
"A mere junior, relying on formations and fate, was able to force the Demon Emperor under my command to retreat, and even forge a romantic relationship to increase his luck. It is really hateful!"
The cold and hoarse voice echoed in the Demon Palace, with murderous intent: "We can no longer let them roam the world safely and accumulate strength. Immediately send an order to send three elders, the black wind monster, the poisonous mist monster, and the mountain cracking rock monster, to intercept and kill them halfway! There is no need to attack and fight to the death, just delay their journey, consume their divine power, disturb their minds, interrupt their way of rest, and frustrate their righteousness!"
Three cold black shadows immediately bowed out of the magic mist to accept the order, and then turned into three sky-piercing black lights, tearing the void, and rushed towards the southwest important road where the five people were traveling. They ambush among the mountains and canyons in advance, quietly waiting for the prey to come.
In mid-air, He Nian suddenly frowned slightly, and the white timing patterns all over his body suddenly trembled slightly, and he spoke in a deep voice to remind everyone: "Everyone, please pay attention, the air in the canyon ahead is extremely turbid, and the evil spirits are gathering together. This is definitely not a natural phenomenon in the mountains. There should be evil spirits deliberately ambushing and blocking it."
After the words fell, the other four people instantly calmed down their emotions, lost their warmth and relaxation, and their expressions all became solemn and vigilant.
He Yue's eyes penetrated the layers of clouds and mist, looking at the deep and long canyon ahead. The silver spiritual power was quietly circulating around her body: "The evil energy is thick and messy, and it is not a unified magic energy. It seems that there is more than one person coming to stop it, and there are at least three evil beings."
Hua Yue's emerald spiritual consciousness was spread out, and he followed the mountains and ravines to detect the movement in the dark. His beautiful eyebrows were furrowed and he said: "The aura is ferocious and savage, and the body is full of murderous aura. They are all old evil monsters that have been devouring creatures and entrenching the mountains all year round. They have good cultivation and are good at close combat and poisonous plots. They should not be taken lightly."
He Ri immediately stood up and took half a step forward, guarding Gongsun Li firmly behind him. The scorching golden light around him suddenly became sharp and sharp, and the hot and bright aura spread out in all directions, dispelling the cold and turbid air around him. He said loudly: "Since you have come for me, let's defeat them together! Ali, follow me closely. Let us jointly deal with the three evil monsters."
Gongsun Li nodded lightly, put away the tenderness in his heart, held the umbrella and concentrated on alert, the aura of pastel flowers lingered around his body, and the spiritual power of dance was ready to go, he was already ready to do a good job.Prepare for the same battle.
The five people slowed down their flight speed and landed slowly on the mountain top at the entrance of the canyon. The rocks at the foot are hard and cold, the mountains on both sides are steep and precipitous, the valley is filled with dark fog that blocks out the sun, the wind is howling incessantly, and the vegetation is all withered and black, giving it an eerie and evil appearance.
As soon as they landed, three violent and fierce figures immediately stepped out from the black mist of the canyon. They were firmly separated in three directions, blocking the way of the five people, forming an encirclement on three sides, leaving no room for them to escape.
To the left of the leader is a tall and sturdy black wind beast covered in dark bristles. The fangs are turned outwards and are terrifying, the eyes are glowing with bloodthirsty red light, the limbs are thick and powerful, the claws are glowing with cold light, the black wind is whistling around the body, and the sky is covered with rubble when it moves. It is naturally good at high-speed raids, tearing the flesh with claws, and has a ferocious and bloodthirsty temperament.
On the right side, a poisonous mist Gu monster with a rickety body and a dark blue color stood quietly. The body is covered with strange lines of poisonous insects, and gray-green poisonous smoke is constantly puffed out from the mouth and nose. The air around the body is contaminated and corroded by the poison. He is good at releasing poisonous miasma, controlling poisonous insects to attack sneakily, and is vicious and cunning, killing people invisibly.
Directly in the center, a mountain-cracking rock monster with a body as thick as a mountain and covered in rock armor stands calmly. The body is huge and bulky, and the arms are like huge rock iron pillars. One punch can shatter mountains and break rock formations. The defense is indestructible, and the brute force can shake the heaven and the earth. It is a real human shield to attack evil objects.
The three evil monsters looked fiercely at the five people in front of them, and their hoarse and strange laughter sounded one after another, echoing in the deep canyon.
"Hahaha, Gods of Time, Taoyuan Spirit Girl, I didn't expect you to travel so fast, but you saved me the trouble of searching!" The black wind monster shook its sharp claws, its fangs rubbed against each other and made a piercing sound. Its eyes were full of greed and murderous intent. "The Demon Lord has an order to stop you and interrupt your search for the remnant. Don't even think about crossing the canyon safely from here today!"
The poisonous mist Gu monster made a sizzling noise from its throat, and the gray-green poisonous mist slowly spread outwards, corroding the surrounding mountains, rocks, vegetation, and trees. He smiled coldly: "You have ruined major events in my demon world one after another and killed countless demon soldiers and generals. Now that your luck is at its peak and you are in love, it just happened to hit you hard here, breaking up the bonds between each other, and ruining the prosperous destiny of the righteous path!"
The mountain-cracking rock monster's voice was as dull as the roar of a rolling stone. His thick body leaned forward slightly, and his majestic brute force was ready to go out: "No need to talk nonsense, just stop it! If I can hold you back, it will be a great achievement. If I can kill a few people, it will be a great achievement!"
The three evil monsters have a clear division of labor. The beast monster mainly attacks in surprise attacks, the Gu monster secretly releases poison and sneak attacks, and the rock monster crushes them head-on. The three have cooperated for many years, and their offense and defense complement each other. Their combined power cannot be underestimated. It is obvious that the demon lord specially selected the men to block the road.
He Nian looked calm and indifferent, standing in the formation and coordinating the overall situation, with the power of time flowing around him, and said calmly: "The demon world has repeatedly refused to give up, and sent people to intercept and block them again and again. Since they insist on seeking death, today they will defeat them all and clear the way forward."
"The three of them each have their own strengths, so they cannot divide their fighting power and still use the five-image formation to face the enemy. The beast monster is fast and ferocious, so let him control it head-on; the Gu monster is vicious and cunning. At the beginning of the month, the flowers and trees use the vitality of vegetation to purify the poisonous miasma and overcome it. Control poisonous insects; the rock monster has strong brute strength, and I and the power of time limit its movements; He Yue, you calm your mind and beware of evil monsters’ disturbing tricks; A Li wanders on the flanks, waiting for opportunities to control the field with the aura of his umbrella shadow.”
In just a short moment, the enemy's layout was clearly arranged, and the five people adjusted their positions together. The five spiritual powers echoed and connected with each other. The stable five-image formation was once again formed, and they faced the three evil monsters that blocked the road with awe and righteousness.
"You little thing who doesn't know how to live or die, still dare to line up to fight? Then let you see the power of my three monsters working together!"
The black wind monster was the first to be unable to hold back. He suddenly crushed the rocks under his feet, and his body transformed into aThe dark and violent wind was carrying strong winds that tore through the airflow. The cold light of the sharp claws was directed towards He Ri's face. The speed was as fast as lightning. The attack was fierce and cunning, and it was a killing move.
